meta.game: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (N64 100% definition)
meta.subtitle: Switch 2 remake — midnight-launch one-sitting 100% binge route
meta.scope: Structured to mirror the Zelda Dungeon walkthrough exactly — same 14 chapters and numbered sections, same path. 36 Heart Pieces, 100 Gold Skulltulas (both in Zelda Dungeon's collection-order numbering), 12 songs, all equipment/items/upgrades, 4 bottles, 6 Great Fairies, 3 Spiritual Stones, 6 Medallions, every dungeon.
meta.confidencePolicy: Chapters, sections, path order, collectible placement and ALL missable/time-sensitive callouts are taken from the Zelda Dungeon walkthrough. Follow top to bottom and use the ⚠ missable notes. Trust the in-game counters over any wording.
meta.remakeNote: Built pre-release on the original N64 baseline. Patch in remake-specific changes on launch night.
meta.sources: Structure, path & missables: zeldadungeon.net/ocarina-of-time-walkthrough (14 chapters, ~60 sections). HP/GS numbering follows Zelda Dungeon's collection order.
missablesSummary: Many Gold Skulltulas & Heart Pieces are NIGHT-only — play Sun's Song to toggle night.
Compose the Scarecrow's Song as a child at Lake Hylia (§3.5b) — gates several adult pickups.

Buy ALL Magic Beans (only sold once, §5.1) and PLANT them as a child: Graveyard (§6.2), Death Mountain Crater (§8.2), Desert Colossus (§13.3), plus Zora's River/Lost Woods/Lake — they grow into adult platforms.
Dampé's gravedigging HP is a random ~10% drop, night 18:00–21:00 only (§3.1).
Biggoron's Sword trade has TIMED legs: 3 min / 3 min / 4 min (§9.4).
Child-only: frog Heart Pieces (§11.2), Bottom of the Well (§11.3), Treasure Chest Game HP (§11.4), Spirit Temple child half (§13.4).
Final 100% audit before entering Ganon's Castle (§14.4).

phases.title: Chapter 1 · Inside the Deku Tree
phases.blurb: Wake up, gear up, clear the first dungeon, earn the first Spiritual Stone.

steps.title: 1.1 Boy Without a Fairy
steps.do: Opening cutscenes; Navi joins you.

steps.title: 1.2 Kokiri Forest
steps.do: Get the sword from the training-path hole, buy a Deku Shield, then talk to Mido with both equipped.

items.label: Kokiri Sword
Deku Shield

steps.title: 1.3 Inside the Deku Tree
steps.do: Work down the dungeon; grab the Slingshot. GS #1–3 are child-only — get them on the way.

items.label: Fairy Slingshot

GS #1 — Jump down and kill the Big Skulltula on the right, then the Deku Baba in front of the vines. Once they’re both dead, climb back up the vines, then step on the switch again and use the platforms to get to the left alcove this time.
GS #2 — Look back up at the vines that lead back to the upper floor. There is a Gold Skulltula crawling around.
GS #3 — There is another Gold Skulltula, this one on the grating at the north end of the room. Use your Slingshot to kill it and then jump over from the nearby platform to claim the token.

steps.title: 1.4 Kokiri's Emerald
steps.do: Beat Queen Gohma (boss Heart Container), receive the first Spiritual Stone.

items.label: Inside the Deku Tree (cleared)
Kokiri's Emerald

phases.title: Chapter 2 · Princess of Destiny
phases.blurb: Cross Hyrule Field, meet Zelda, learn Zelda's Lullaby, start the trade chain.

steps.title: 2.1 Leaving Kokiri Forest
steps.do: Mido blocks then leaves; head out to Hyrule Field (you get the Fairy Ocarina). Reach the Market before nightfall or the drawbridge closes.
steps.missableNote: Reach Castle Town before night or the drawbridge raises (you'll be locked out until morning). At night, Stalchildren spawn in the field.

steps.title: 2.2 Castle Town Market
steps.do: Optional shooting-gallery Bullet Bag upgrade and GS #4 in the guardhouse.

items.label: GS #4 — Once you enter the Market, immediately enter the first door you come to on the overhead view screen. This is a guardhouse where the soldier on duty is supposed to be watching the crates and jars to make sure nobody busts them up.
Bullet Bag upgrade (Slingshot ammo 30→40)

steps.title: 2.3 Hyrule Castle
steps.do: Sneak to the courtyard, meet Zelda, get the Weird Egg (→Cucco→Zelda's Letter) and learn Zelda's Lullaby from Impa. GS #5 in the tree on the path.

items.label: GS #5 — Once you enter the area that leads to Hyrule Castle, there is tree to the left. Roll into the tree and the Skulltula will fall out.
Zelda's Lullaby
Weird Egg → Cucco → Zelda's Letter (trade chain begun)

phases.title: Chapter 3 · The Mighty Collection
phases.blurb: A big overworld collection sweep. Almost nothing here is required — but it's where the bulk of child-era Heart Pieces, Skulltulas and bottles live.

steps.title: 3.1 Graveyard
steps.do: Get the Hylian Shield and Sun's Song; two graveyard Heart Pieces.

items.label: Sun's Song
Hylian Shield
HP #1 — Beneath a tomb in the second row of the Graveyard. Defeat the ReDead and play the Sun’s Song while standing on the steps of the platform to get a treasure chest to appear.
HP #2 — Play Dampe’s Heart-Pounding Gravedigging Tour mini-game. While there are rupee rewards, the main objective is to collect a heart piece.

steps.missableNote: HP #1 (Sun's-Song ReDead grave) and HP #2 (Dampé's gravedigging) both need NIGHT — Dampé only digs 18:00–21:00 and the Heart Piece is a ~10% random drop per dig, so keep paying/digging until it appears. Play Sun's Song to force night.

steps.title: 3.2 Kakariko Village
steps.do: Round up the Cuccos for Bottle #1, then sweep six night-time Skulltulas; claim the Adult's Wallet at 10 tokens.

items.label: Bottle #1 (Cucco Lady)
Adult's Wallet (10 GS reward)
GS #6 — Take a bottle of bugs to the Graveyard near the Soft Soil location. Release the bugs onto the soil location and a Gold Skulltula will pop out of the ground.
GS #7 — On one of the unfinished walls of the construction area.
GS #8 — On the side of the Skulltula House….
GS #9 — Roll into the tree in the center of the village. Just don’t let it fall on you.
GS #10 — On the ladder of the lookout tower. Shoot it and climb up to snag the token.
GS #11 — Against the side of the building closest to the base of Death Mountain. Next, we’re going to enter the House of Skulltula , which is right across from the construction area.

steps.missableNote: GS #7–11 only appear at NIGHT — play Sun's Song first. GS #6 needs a bottle of bugs dropped on the grave-side soft soil.

steps.title: 3.3 Lon Lon Ranch
steps.do: Learn Epona's Song, win Talon's game for Bottle #2, grab HP #3 and two Skulltulas.

items.label: Epona's Song
Bottle #2 (Lon Lon Milk)
HP #3 — Located inside the building at the southwest corner of Lon Lon Ranch. Push/Pull the crates out of the way to reach the corner and then crawl through to find the heart piece.
GS #12 — At Lon Lon Ranch, once you pass the initial buildings when you enter, take a left and you’ll find a lone tree. Roll into it and the Skulltula will fall down.
GS #13 — Found on the outside of the corral at Lon Lon Ranch. The Skulltula is only seen at nighttime, where is it hanging out on the wooden board.

steps.missableNote: GS #13 is night-only (on the corral fence).

steps.title: 3.4 Gerudo Valley
steps.do: Two Heart Pieces and a soft-soil Skulltula at the valley.

items.label: HP #4 — Located behind the waterfall in Gerudo Valley. Climb the ladder to reach the heart piece.
HP #5 — Grab the Cucco in Gerudo Valley and look to the left of the bridge. There is a platform with a crate.
GS #14 — At the bottom of Gerudo Valley you will find a Gerudo, a Cow, and a soft soil location. Drop some bugs into the soil location to get the Skulltula.

steps.title: 3.5 Lake Hylia
steps.do: Fishing-pond Heart Piece, two Skulltulas — and set up the Scarecrow's Song now.

items.label: HP #6 — At the Lake Hylia Fishing Pond, catch a fish that is at least 10 pounds to get the heart piece.
GS #15 — At Lake Hylia, there is a soft soil location right next to the Lakeside Laboratory. Drop some bugs into the soil spot to get the Skulltula.
GS #16 — At Lake Hylia, on the island at the southeast corner of the map. This Gold Skulltula will only appear at nighttime.

steps.missableNote: SET UP THE SCARECROW'S SONG AS A CHILD: sing any 8-note tune to Bonooru the scarecrow at Lake Hylia now. As an adult you replay it to summon Pierre — it's required/handy for HP #23, GS #61, GS #77 and other out-of-reach spots. GS #16 is night-only.

steps.title: 3.5b Scarecrow's Song
steps.do: Compose an 8-note song for Bonooru the scarecrow (write down what you played!).
steps.missableNote: This is the single easiest thing to forget. Without it, several adult Heart Pieces / Skulltulas are far harder. Compose it as a child; you'll reuse the same notes as an adult.

steps.title: 3.6 Lost Woods
steps.do: Learn Saria's Song, grab two Skull-Kid Heart Pieces, four Skulltulas, a Deku Stick upgrade and a second Bullet Bag upgrade.

items.label: Saria's Song
HP #7 — From the entrance of the Lost Woods, make a right and drop down into the lower area. Stand on the tree stump and pull out the Ocarina.
HP #8 — From the entrance of the Lost Woods, make a right and and stand on the tree stump. Play Saria’s Song for the Skull Kid to get a piece of heart.
GS #17 — Found only at nighttime in the Kokiri Forest. The skulltula is on the backside of the Know-It-All-Brothers’ House, located at the southwest part of the town.
GS #18 — From the entrance of the Lost Woods, go left and left again. Drop some bugs into the Soft Soil and the Skulltula will pop out.
GS #19 — From the entrance of the Lost Woods, go right, left, right, left, and left to find yourself in a Meadow. Walk forward and you’ll find a Soft Soil location.
GS #20 — Back on Kokiri Forest, make your way to the Shop where you bought a Deku Shield. Right behind it, drop some bugs into the Soft Soil location and a Skulltula will pop out.
Deku Stick capacity #1
Bullet Bag upgrade #2 (40→50)

steps.missableNote: GS #17 (Kokiri Forest) is night-only.

steps.title: 3.7 Collection Wrap-Up
steps.do: Night-time Market dog quest for HP #9.

items.label: HP #9 — At nighttime in the Market, find the dog Richard, who is hanging out by the blue street vender stand. Lead Richard to the back ally on the other side of the market and talk to the woman inside the building to get a piece of heart.

steps.missableNote: HP #9 needs NIGHT: lead the white dog Richard to the back-alley woman.

phases.title: Chapter 4 · Dodongo's Cavern
phases.blurb: Up Death Mountain for the Goron's Bracelet and Bomb Bag, clear the second dungeon, then sweep bomb-gated goodies.

steps.title: 4.1 Goron City
steps.do: Play Saria's Song for Darunia (Goron's Bracelet), grab HP #10 and the soft-soil GS #21 outside the cavern.

items.label: Goron's Bracelet
HP #10 — Grab a bomb a flower and toss it into the spinning urn at Goron City. If you do so while the urn is facing forward and smiling, a piece of heart will appear.
GS #21 — Just outside of Dodongo’s Cavern, drop some bugs into the Soft Soil location and a Skulltula will pop out.

steps.title: 4.2 Dodongo's Cavern
steps.do: Get the Bomb Bag; three Skulltulas inside (one bombable, two need a return — grab what you can now).

items.label: Bomb Bag
GS #22 — In the room without the giant staircase, climb up to the very top and walk around to the south part of the room. Use the Slingshot to defeat the Skulltula and climb up to get the token.

GS #23 — From the entrance of the dungeon, head through the southeast door to reach the room with the Baby Dodongo’s. Blast away at the wall with a bomb and head down a room where you will find the Gold SKulltula.
GS #24 — In the room with the Fire Keese towards the end of the dungeon there is a bombable wall at the north end of the room. Blast it open and you’ll find a Gold Skulltula behind the armos statue.

steps.title: 4.3 Atop Death Mountain
steps.do: Beat King Dodongo for Goron's Ruby; Magic Meter Great Fairy; bigger Bomb Bag, two Heart Pieces, three Skulltulas.

items.label: Dodongo's Cavern (cleared)
Goron's Ruby
Great Fairy — Magic Meter
Bomb Bag upgrade (30)

HP #11 — Climb down the side of the wall in the Death Mountain Crater to find a small cubby in the wall with a heart piece. Atop Death Mountain – With those items in hand, swerve around the bird for now and lay a Bomb against the funny loo.
HP #12 — After flying down Death Mountain using the owl, carefully drop down onto the edge to the east. Enter the house here to find the Piece of Heart.
GS #25 — On the trail between Kakariko Village and Dodongo’s Cavern, there is a bombable wall on the side where you can hear a Gold Skulltula. Bomb the wall and defeat the skulltula for the token.
GS #26 — Once you enter Goron City, bomb the three boulders on the left. This leads to a room where you should bomb the boulders along the right path.
GS #27 — At the very top of Death Mountain, enter the Death Mountain Crater and you’ll find a wooden crate. Roll into it to find a Gold Skulltula.

steps.title: 4.4 Fun With Bombs
steps.do: Bombchu Bowling (HP #13) and the Hyrule Field scrub grotto (HP #14); Bombchus, Din's Fire Great Fairy, biggest Bomb Bag.

items.label: Bombchus
Great Fairy — Din's Fire
Bomb Bag upgrade (40, biggest)
HP #13 — Play the Bombchu Bowling mini-game at Castle Town and one of the prizes will be a Piece of Heart. It cycles through five prizes, so it might take a few tries before this one appears.

HP #14 — In the fenced area at the southwest portion of Hyrule Field, near the entrance of Lake Hylia. Drop a bomb to find an underground grotto where there is a Business Scrub that will sell you the heart piece for 10 rupees.

steps.missableNote: HP #13 (Bombchu Bowling) cycles 5 prizes — it may take several plays for the Heart Piece (and a Bomb Bag prize) to appear; you can always come back.

phases.title: Chapter 5 · Inside Jabu-Jabu's Belly
phases.blurb: Zora's River and Domain, the third dungeon and final Spiritual Stone — and BUY/PLANT THE MAGIC BEANS.

steps.title: 5.1 Zora's River
steps.do: Two cucco Heart Pieces, two Skulltulas — and buy every Magic Bean from the salesman.

items.label: Magic Beans (buy the full set)
HP #15 — In Zora’s River, grab the Cucco at the start of the area and carry it down the path of the river. In the open area there is a heart piece on a pillar in the water.
HP #16 — In Zora’s River, carry a Cucco all the way to the end of the river, near the waterfall. While standing right next to the waterfall turn around to find a heart piece.
GS #28 — At the entrance of Zora’s River, roll into the first tree and a Gold Skulltula will pop out.
GS #29 — At the end of Zora’s River, right near the waterfall, there is a ladder leading out of the water. At nighttime a Skulltula can be found here.

steps.missableNote: BUY ALL THE MAGIC BEANS — this salesman is the ONLY source, and beans planted now (as a child) grow into platforms you need as an adult for several Heart Pieces/Skulltulas. (The bean-salesman's own soft-soil patch is the one and only soft soil in the game with NO Gold Skulltula — don't waste bugs there.) GS #29 is night-only.

steps.title: 5.2 Zora's Domain
steps.do: Win the diving game (Silver Scale), light the torches for HP #17, get the Ruto's-Letter bottle (Bottle #3) and GS #30.

items.label: Silver Scale
Bottle #3 (Ruto's Letter)
HP #17 — Use a Deku Stick to light all five torches on fire. A treasure chest containing the heart piece will appear behind the waterfall.
GS #30 — At the southeast portion of Zora’s Fountain, roll into the lone tree here and the Skulltula will pop out. If you look against the wall here you’ll find two boulders.

steps.title: 5.3 Inside Jabu-Jabu's Belly
steps.do: Get the Boomerang; four Skulltulas (two need the Boomerang).

items.label: Boomerang
GS #31 — After meeting Ruto and falling down below. You’ll pick her up and bring her to a room with a floor switch.
GS #32 — After falling down to the lower floor for a second time, you’ll find two Skulltulas on the wall. Defeat them and use the Boomerang to grab the closer token.
GS #33 — After falling down to the lower floor for a second time, you’ll find two Skulltulas on the wall. Defeat them and use the Boomerang to grab the further token.
GS #34 — In the final room before the boss, there is a Gold Skulltula on the vines. Defeat it and grab the token.

steps.title: 5.4 Spiritual Stone of Water
steps.do: Beat Barinade for Zora's Sapphire; GS #35; grab Farore's Wind from the Zora's Fountain Great Fairy.

items.label: Inside Jabu-Jabu's Belly (cleared)
Zora's Sapphire
Great Fairy — Farore's Wind
GS #35 — At Zora’s Fountain, stand on the log just south of Lord Jabu-Jabu. At nighttime there will be a Skulltula crawling around on the wall.

steps.title: 5.5 Fun With The Boomerang
steps.do: With the Boomerang, sweep nine more Skulltulas worldwide (incl. a return into the Deku Tree). Claim the Giant's Wallet at 30 tokens.

items.label: Giant's Wallet (30 GS reward)
GS #36 — Way back inside of the Great Deku Tree. There was a room in the first Basement at the northwest corner of the map that we previously never entered.
GS #37 — Once you enter Lon Lon Ranch at nighttime, you will find a Gold Skulltula on the window of the building on the left side. Defeat the spider and collect the token with the Boomerang.
GS #38 — At Lon Lon Ranch at nighttime, make your way to the far southwest side of the map. Higher up on the edge you will find a Skulltula.
GS #39 — At the west end of Hyrule Field, near the entrance of Gerudo Valley, you will find a circle of rocks. The Shard of Agony will chime if you stand in the middle.
GS #40 — Once you enter Gerudo Valley, walk forward and you’ll come to a wooden ramp. If you turn to the right, there is some water coming out of a hole in the wall.
GS #41 — At the northwest side of Lake Hylia, walk onto the bridge near the Lakeside Laboratory. At nighttime look at the building and you’ll find a Skulltula.
GS #42 — Located in Hyrule Field, right near the entrance to Kakariko Village. Just north of the small bridge that is between Castle Town and Kakariko Village, you will find a tree.
GS #43 — Found on the wall at the southeast corner of the Graveyard. The Skulltula can be found at nighttime and you’ll need the Boomerang to retrieve the token.
GS #44 — The Gold Skulltula is located in Dodongo’s Cavern, within the room with the massive explodable staircase. However, you’ll have to go the long route to get this one.

steps.missableNote: Several here are night-only and/or need the Boomerang (a child-only item): GS #37, #38 (Lon Lon, night), #41 (Lake Hylia, night), #43 (Graveyard, night + Boomerang).

phases.title: Chapter 6 · Timely Appearance
phases.blurb: Open the Door of Time, finish the mask trade, pull the Master Sword.

steps.title: 6.1 Ocarina of Time
steps.do: Get the Ocarina of Time and Song of Time from Zelda; open the Door of Time.

items.label: Song of Time
Ocarina of Time

steps.title: 6.2 Getting the Mask of Truth
steps.do: Run the whole mask chain to the Mask of Truth; collect Deku Stick #2 and Deku Nut #2 upgrades at the Deku Theater. Plant a Magic Bean in the Graveyard now.

items.label: Happy Mask sequence → Mask of Truth
Deku Stick capacity #2
Deku Nut capacity #2

steps.missableNote: PLANT A MAGIC BEAN in the Graveyard soft soil while you're here as a child — it grows into the platform for HP #18 later. Easy to forget.

steps.title: 6.3 Awaken the Hero of Time
steps.do: Pull the Master Sword → become adult; Rauru gives the Light Medallion. (You can return to childhood anytime via the pedestal.)

items.label: Master Sword
Light Medallion

phases.title: Chapter 7 · Forest Temple
phases.blurb: Get Epona and the Hookshot, sweep Hookshot goodies, clear the Forest Temple, then the final bottle.

steps.title: 7.1 Getting Epona
steps.do: Beat Ingo's horse race to win Epona (fast Hyrule Field travel via Epona's Song).

steps.title: 7.2 Getting the Hookshot
steps.do: Race Dampé's ghost for the Hookshot; HP #18 (grown Graveyard bean) and HP #19 (windmill).

items.label: Hookshot

HP #18 — In the Graveyard, if you planted a Magic Bean as a child, there will be a Magic Bean flower that has grown. Ride it up to the higher ledge and roll into the wooden box to find the heart piece.
HP #19 — Found inside the Windmill. It is easiest to acquire this Heart Piece after completing Dampe’s race and acquiring the Hookshot.

steps.missableNote: HP #18 needs the Magic Bean you planted in the Graveyard as a child (§6.2). If you forgot it, you'll have to plant one and wait.

steps.title: 7.3 Hookshot Goodies
steps.do: HP #20 (Dampé race record) and HP #21 (windmill roof); GS #45, #46.

items.label: HP #20 — After acquiring the Hookshot from Dampe, return to his grave and speak with him again. You can race him once again.

HP #21 — In Kakariko Village, right when you come out of the Windmill, jump onto the fence that is straight ahead. From here, you can use your Hookshot to get on top of the building just to the right.
GS #45 — Make your way to the south end of Kakariko Village, next to Impa’s House. From here, Hookshot onto the roof of the SKulltula House and then Hookshot onto the roof of Impa’s House.
GS #46 — Return to the Market and make your way to where Hyrule Castle use to be. You’ll find that it is now Ganon’s Castle.

steps.title: 7.4 Return to the Forest
steps.do: Learn Minuet of Forest; three Skulltulas on the way in.

items.label: Minuet of Forest

GS #47 — At nighttime in Kokiri Forest, make your way over to the Twins’ House, located at the southeast part of the forest. Use your Hookshot to defeat a Skulltula that is located above the building.
GS #48 — At nighttime in the Meadow of the Lost Woods. Take the Magic Bean Plant ride up to the top and slash away at the Gold Skulltula.
GS #49 — At nighttime in the Sacred Forest Meadow, climb up the ladder to the higher ledge and look up at the east wall. There is a gold skulltula that you can defeat with the Hookshot.

steps.missableNote: GS #47 (Kokiri Twins' House) and #48/#49 (Lost Woods/Meadow) are night-only; #48 needs the grown Magic Bean.

steps.title: 7.5 Forest Temple
steps.do: Get the Fairy Bow; five Skulltulas inside.

items.label: Fairy Bow
GS #50 — In the first room of the dungeon, climb the vines on the right side. Use the Hookshot to defeat the Gold Skulltula.
GS #51 — In the large central room, run straight ahead to the north door. Look at the wall to the right and you’ll find the Gold Skulltula.

GS #52 — In the wide open room northwest of the center room, you’ll find a treasure chest on a higher ledge. Use the Hookshot to latch on to the front of the chest, pulling you up to the higher ledge.
GS #53 — When you reenter the Northwest Room with the ruins, jump over to the narrow platform. From there look up against the wall and you’ll find the Gold Skulltula.
GS #54 — In the Basement of the Forest Temple, just before the boss, there is a Gold Skulltula located in the room with the Treasure Chest.

steps.title: 7.6 Post-Temple Goodies
steps.do: Forest Medallion; Prelude of Light from Sheik; HP #22 (50-GS reward); the Big Quiver.

items.label: Forest Temple (cleared)
Forest Medallion
Prelude of Light
Quiver upgrade (Big, 40)
HP #22 — If you’ve been following the guide, we have collected more than 50 Gold Skulltulas at this point. You can enter the Skulltula House to claim your newest prize, a piece of heart.

steps.title: 7.7 The Final Bottle
steps.do: Catch Big Poes on Epona at night and sell them for Bottle #4.

items.label: Bottle #4 (Big Poe)

phases.title: Chapter 8 · Fire Temple
phases.blurb: Lake Hylia goodies, Goron Tunic, the Fire Temple and the Megaton Hammer.

steps.title: 8.1 Lake Hylia
steps.do: Golden Scale (fishing) plus three Heart Pieces.

items.label: Golden Scale

HP #23 — Just outside the Lakeside Laboratory at Lake Hylia, we want to get on top of the building. You can do so by riding the Magic Bean Plant that has grown, or by playing the Scarecrow’s Song and using the Hookshot.
HP #24 — Inside the Lakeside Laboratory, jump into the small pool of water. Dive down all the way to the bottom of the tank.
HP #25 — Place a bomb near a tree, northwest of Lon Lon Ranch to find a hidden grotto. Underground, jump into the water and dive down below to find a piece of heart at the bottom of the pond.

steps.missableNote: HP #23 (lab roof) uses the grown bean OR the Scarecrow's Song + Hookshot — another reason the Scarecrow setup (§3.5b) matters.

steps.title: 8.2 Death Mountain Revisited
steps.do: Goron Tunic; two Skulltulas (#55, #56); HP #26 (Dodongo entrance bean). Plant a Magic Bean in the Crater.

items.label: Goron Tunic

HP #26 — At the entrance of Dodongo’s Cavern, you can ride the Magic Bean Plant up to get onto the higher ledge where a heart container is located. You could have actually gotten this as a Child with a strategy jump, but this is the intend.

GS #55 — Re-enter Dodongo’s Cavern and make your way to the room at the southeast part of the main room. This is the room with the Baby Dodongo’s and if you pay close attention, you’ll notice Navi will fly up to a higher ledge and turn gre.
GS #56 — Once you enter Goron City, walk across the tightropes that are straight ahead. On the backside of the pedestal located at the top of the City, you will find a Gold Skulltula.

steps.missableNote: PLANT A MAGIC BEAN in the Death Mountain Crater soft soil now — it grows for HP #27. GS #56 is night-only.

steps.title: 8.3 Death Mountain Crater
steps.do: Learn Bolero of Fire; HP #27 (bean to pillar) and GS #57.

items.label: Bolero of Fire
HP #27 — Inside of the Death Mountain Crater, ride the Magic Bean Plant to get to the higher up volcano-like mountain to snag a heart piece.
GS #57 — Once you have learned the Bolero of Fire, warp to the Death Mountain Crater as a child. Drop some bugs into the soft soil location to get the Skulltula to appear.

steps.missableNote: GS #57: warp here AS A CHILD with the Bolero and drop bugs in the crater soft soil.

steps.title: 8.4 Fire Temple
steps.do: Get the Megaton Hammer; five Skulltulas.

items.label: Megaton Hammer

GS #58 — In the large lava room with the broken bridge, found very early in the dungeon, turn to the left and you’ll find a Song of Time Block on a higher ledge. Stand on the lower platform and play the Song of Time when Navi turns green.

GS #59 — In the boulder maze room of the Fire Temple, there is a bombable wall near the northeast portion of the room. You can slash your sword against the wall and the false sound of the wall will indicate it can be bombed.

GS #60 — In the boulder maze room of the Fire Temple, once you are on the higher level after passing through the room where the fire is chasing you, turn to the right and play the Scarecrow’s Song. Hookshot to Pierre and then Hookshot to t.
GS #61 — After using the Scarecrow’s Song and riding the secret elevator, climb up to the large open room. Walk close to the edge and turn to the left to find a Skulltula on the wall.
GS #62 — In the room just before the second battle with the Flare Dancer, block all the Floor Tiles and defeat the Like-Like. The skulltula is found on the back wall.

steps.missableNote: GS #61 uses the Scarecrow's Song to reach a hidden elevator/ledge.

steps.title: 8.5 Fun with the Hammer
steps.do: Fire Medallion; Double Magic (Great Fairy of Wisdom); GS #63, #64 (Hammer/night boulders).

items.label: Fire Temple (cleared)
Fire Medallion
Great Fairy — Double Magic
GS #63 — Located on the Death Mountain Trail, in the area where there were falling boulders as a child. There are three rocks on this trail that you cannot break with bombs.
GS #64 — Located on the Death Mountain Trail, near the entrance to Goron City. There is boulder located just above Dodongo’s Cavern and you’ll need the Megaton Hammer to break it.

steps.missableNote: GS #63 and #64 are under Death Mountain Trail boulders broken with the Megaton Hammer — at night.

phases.title: Chapter 9 · Ice Cavern
phases.blurb: Zora's River/Domain revisited, the Ice Cavern (Iron Boots), the Zora Tunic, and the Biggoron trade.

steps.title: 9.1 Zora's Domain Revisited
steps.do: Three Skulltulas (#65 bean, #66, #67) and HP #28 (ice platform).

items.label: HP #28 — In Zora’s Fountain, jump across the ice platforms that lead to the Ice Cavern. One of the ice platforms in the distance has a heart piece and you’ll easily be able to jump to it.
GS #65 — In Zora’s River, located high up on the southern wall. Ride the Magic Bean up to the large plateau in the center of the River.

GS #66 — In Zora’s River, once you cross the small river, heading towards Zora’s Domain, if you look up high at the wall, you’ll find a Gold Skulltula. It is just out of reach from when you are standing on the ground.
GS #67 — Found inside of Zora’s Domain, there is a Skulltula near the top of the frozen waterfall. Go through King Zora’s Chamber and walk right up to the edge.

steps.title: 9.2 Ice Cavern
steps.do: Iron Boots, Serenade of Water, HP #29 (red ice) and three Skulltulas. Keep a bottle of Blue Fire.

items.label: Iron Boots
Serenade of Water
Ice Cavern (cleared)
HP #29 — In the Ice Cavern in the room with the Compass, a piece of heart can be found within a red block of ice. Use Blue Fire to melt it and snag the heart piece.
GS #68 — In the Ice Cavern, make your way to the first spinning blade room with the Silver Rupees. The skulltula is located high up on the wall, just above one of the silver rupees.
GS #69 — In the Ice Cavern in the room with the Compass, the Gold Skulltula is hidden up on a higher pillar. Use the Hookshot to grab the skulltula token.
GS #70 — In the large block pushing room of the Ice Cavern, the Gold Skulltula is found waiting on one of the higher walls. The goal in this room is obviously to get all the Silver Rupees.

steps.title: 9.3 Zora Tunic
steps.do: Get the Zora Tunic; HP #30 at the bottom of Zora's Fountain (Iron Boots).

items.label: Zora Tunic
HP #30 — Located at the very bottom of Zora’s Fountain. Use the Iron Boots to reach the ground floor and collect the heart piece.

steps.title: 9.4 Biggoron Sword Trading Sequence
steps.do: The long adult trade chain ending in Biggoron's Sword.

items.label: Biggoron's Sword
Biggoron trade chain complete

steps.missableNote: TIMED LEGS — don't dawdle: Odd Mushroom → Odd Potion (3 minutes), Eyeball Frog → World's Finest Eye Drops (3 minutes), Eye Drops → Claim Check (4 minutes, hardest). If a timer runs out the item reverts and you redo that leg (not permanently lost). Warping (Bolero/Serenade/etc.) saves the run.

phases.title: Chapter 10 · Water Temple
phases.blurb: Drain and conquer the Water Temple for the Longshot and Water Medallion.

steps.title: 10.1 Enter the Water Temple
steps.do: GS #71 in the Lakeside Lab (Iron Boots + crate).

items.label: GS #71 — Enter the Lakeside Laboratory and use the Iron Boots to sink down to the bottom of the small pool. Roll into the wooden crate here and and a Skulltula will pop out.

steps.title: 10.2 Water Temple
steps.do: Longshot, Water Medallion, five Skulltulas; beat Dark Link and Morpha.

items.label: Longshot
Water Temple (cleared)
Water Medallion
GS #72 — On the lowest level of the main chamber, walk through the south path and bomb the floor. Travel to the next room, step on the switch, and hookshot over to the target.

GS #73 — After acquiring the Longshot and traveling through the area with the vortexes in the water, you’ll find a Skulltula on one of the walls. Use the Iron Boots and Longshot to defeat the Skulltula while in the water.
GS #74 — Once you have the Longshot, return to the room west of the main chamber on the highest floor. Use the Longshot to defeat the Skulltula on the wall to the right and snag the Gold Skulltula.

GS #75 — Inside the large central pillar of the main room, once you have the Longshot, you will be able to defeat a Skulltula all the way at the top of the room and snag the token. Back in the main room, go and face the south corridor with.
GS #76 — Inch forward to the edge of the floor and look to the right to find a Skulltula. Use the Longshot to defeat it and snag the token.

steps.title: 10.3 Goodies at the Lake
steps.do: Fire Arrows (sunrise on the island) and GS #77.

items.label: Fire Arrows
GS #77 — After acquiring the Longshot, grapple up to the top of the tree, located on the island just above the entrance to the Water Temple. At nighttime, you’ll find a Gold Skulltula up here.

steps.missableNote: GS #77 is night-only (Longshot the tree above the Water Temple entrance).

phases.title: Chapter 11 · Within The Well
phases.blurb: Kakariko burns; learn Nocturne. Travel back to childhood for the frog Heart Pieces and the Bottom of the Well (Lens of Truth).

steps.title: 11.1 Song of Storms
steps.do: Sheik teaches Nocturne of Shadow; Guru-Guru in the windmill teaches Song of Storms.

items.label: Nocturne of Shadow
Song of Storms

steps.title: 11.2 Return to Childhood
steps.loc: Temple of Time → Zora's River / Hyrule Castle
steps.do: Become a child again. GS #78 (Hyrule Castle, Song of Storms) and the two frog Heart Pieces.

items.label: HP #31 — At Zora’s River as a child, near the center of the map, step on the nearby log that sticks out into the water. Pull out your Ocarina to get five Frogs to appear.
HP #32 — At Zora’s River as a child, when you meet the five frogs, play Zelda’s Lullaby, Saria’s Song, Epona’s Song, Sun’s Song, and the Song of Time. Each time one of the frogs will grow in size.
GS #78 — In the area just outside Hyrule Castle, there is a tree in the corner of the gate. Stand next to it and play the Song of Storms.

steps.missableNote: CHILD-ONLY: HP #31/#32 are the Zora's River frogs. HP #32 needs you to play ALL of Zelda's Lullaby, Saria's Song, Epona's Song, Sun's Song and Song of Time for the frogs — make sure you've learned them.

steps.title: 11.3 Bottom of the Well
steps.do: As a child, drain and clear the Well for the Lens of Truth; three Skulltulas.

items.label: Lens of Truth
Bottom of the Well (cleared)
GS #79 — In the center room of the Bottom of the Well, there are two locked doors. The room on the left has a Deku Baba and some flying pots.
GS #80 — In the center room of the Bottom of the Well, there are two locked doors. The room on the right has a bunch of Keese.
GS #81 — At the top-right corner of the Bottom of the Wall, crawl through the small hole and use a key on the locked door. Carefully navigate through this room, avoiding the invisible pits.

steps.missableNote: CHILD-ONLY mini-dungeon — you cannot enter it as an adult. The Lens of Truth here is mandatory for the Shadow Temple.

steps.title: 11.4 Lens of Truth Goodies
steps.do: HP #33 — the Treasure Chest Game with the Lens.

items.label: HP #33 — Using the Lens of Truth, play the Treasure Chest game in the Market at nighttime. The Lens of Truth will allow you to see which treasure chest holds the Small Key, so you can never fail at the game.

steps.missableNote: CHILD + NIGHT: play the Market Treasure Chest Game using the Lens of Truth to win HP #33 without fail.

phases.title: Chapter 12 · Shadow Temple
phases.blurb: Back to adult; warp via Nocturne to the Graveyard and clear the Shadow Temple.

steps.title: 12.1 Graveyard
steps.do: Become an adult and warp with Nocturne of Shadow to the Shadow Temple entrance.

steps.title: 12.2 Shadow Temple
steps.do: Hover Boots; five Skulltulas (Lens of Truth required throughout).

items.label: Hover Boots

GS #82 — After going down the pathway with the guillotines and reaching the lone Stalfos, take the path on the left, using the Lens of Truth. Defeat the Like-Like and all the Keese to unlock the gate and collect the token.
GS #83 — In the room with the spiking falling traps, push the block so that it prevents the falling traps from hitting the ground. Check behind the fence on the left side to find the Gold Skulltula.
GS #84 — The Skulltula can be found in the room with the giant skull, where you have to toss a bomb into it to find a small key. There is a gold skulltula tucked away behind where the skull stood.
GS #85 — Once you arrive on top of the large moving boat, look back to where the shortcut is, which is where the block originally was. Navi will fly up and turn green.
GS #86 — In the room with the invisible walls, just before acquiring the Boss Key, head to the room to the west where you will find three spinning skulls. The Skulltula is hidden just behind them.

steps.title: 12.3 Sage of Shadow
steps.do: Beat Bongo Bongo for the Shadow Medallion.

items.label: Shadow Temple (cleared)
Shadow Medallion

phases.title: Chapter 13 · Spirit Temple
phases.blurb: Free the carpenters, cross the desert, and tackle the Spirit Temple in BOTH eras.

steps.title: 13.1 Rescuing the Carpenters
steps.do: Free the four carpenters for the Gerudo Membership Card; GS #87, #88.

items.label: Gerudo Membership Card
GS #87 — In Gerudo Valley, just behind the Carpenters tent, there is a Skulltula on the back wall. Use your Longshot to defeat it and snag the token.
GS #88 — In Gerudo Valley, once you cross the bridge, there is an archway just to the left. Look up on one of the sides at nighttime to find the Skulltula.

steps.title: 13.2 Gerudo Goodies
steps.do: Horseback archery (HP #35 at 1000, Biggest Quiver at 1500); HP #34 (rooftop Longshot); GS #89, #90.

items.label: Quiver upgrade (Biggest, 50)
HP #34 — At the top of Gerudo Fortress, there is a treasure chest in the distance. If you go right up to the edge, you can reach it with your Longshot.
HP #35 — At back of Gerudo Fortress, jump on your horse to play the archery game. If you successfully score more than 1000 points, you will be rewarded with a piece of heart.
GS #89 — Located near the top of Gerudo Fortress, against back wall. The skulltula is only there at nighttime.
GS #90 — At nighttime in the Gerudo Fortress, head to the back area where the archery game is located. Located on the target at the far end of the area is a Gold Skulltula.

steps.missableNote: GS #89/#90 are night-only (Fortress back wall / archery target).

steps.title: 13.3 Crossing the Desert
steps.do: Cross to the Colossus; Requiem of Spirit; Nayru's Love; HP #36 (bean ride); four Skulltulas. Plant a Magic Bean.

items.label: Requiem of Spirit
Great Fairy — Nayru's Love

HP #36 — Ride the Magic Bean plant and let it take you throughout the entirety of the Desert. It will circle back to near the entrance of the Spirit Temple, where it will travel right beneath a stone arc.

GS #91 — When traveling through the Haunted Wasteland, you’ll come to a lone structure right in the middle of the Desert. Drop down into the below chamber and you’ll find the Skulltula ahead, right between the two torches.

GS #92 — As a child, drop some bugs into the Soft Soil location just outside of the Spirit Temple to get a Gold Skulltula to appear. Plant a Magic Bean here as we will need to ride the Magic Bean Plant as an adult in order to gather all of.
GS #93 — In the Desert Colossus, ride the Magic Bean plant to a large rock, near the north-central potion of the map. Play the Sun’s Song to make it nighttime and you’ll find a Skulltula right here.
GS #94 — Near the Oasis at the south end of the Desert Colossus, you’ll find the Skulltula at the top of one of the Palm Trees at nighttime. Use the Longshot to defeat it and grab the token.

steps.missableNote: PLANT A MAGIC BEAN at the Desert Colossus (needed to ride to HP #36 and GS #93). GS #92 is a CHILD soft-soil drop outside the temple; #93/#94 are night-only (bean ride / palm tree).

steps.title: 13.4 Spirit Temple (Child)
steps.do: Enter as a CHILD via the Requiem; get the Silver Gauntlets; GS #95, #96, #97.

items.label: Silver Gauntlets

GS #95 — As a child in the Spirit Temple, the Gold Skulltula is located in the room found early on with the five silver rupees and wallmaster. Grab the rupees to drop the bridge and then use your Boomerang to snag the token from the Skullt.
GS #96 — As a child in the Spirit Temple, the Skulltula is located in the room with the Bombchu puzzle. Once you enter the room, climb the wall where there are two regular skulltulas.

GS #97 — As a child in the Spirit Temple, the Skulltula is located in the room just before the Iron Knuckle battle. In this narrow hallway, turn around and look at the door you came through and the Skulltula is located just above.

steps.missableNote: CHILD-ONLY half — the last required child segment. Keep the Hylian Shield equipped (Deku Shield can burn). GS #95–97 are child-only here.

steps.title: 13.5 Spirit Temple (Adult)
steps.do: Return as an ADULT for the Mirror Shield; GS #98, #99; beat Twinrova.

items.label: Mirror Shield

GS #98 — As an adult in the Spirit Temple, the Skulltula is located in the room with rolling boulders and five silver rupees. Play the Song of Time in front of time block to find the skulltula hidden right behind.
GS #99 — In the large Colossus room where the giant statue, climb up to the top on the west of the room. Navi will float over to a platform in the distance, so play the Scarecrow’s Song.

steps.title: 13.6 Sage of Spirit
steps.do: Twinrova down → Spirit Medallion.

items.label: Spirit Temple (cleared)
Spirit Medallion
